statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail is low at 16 on a contained overnight NQ range, while Stress stays high at 67 because of a 24-year high in the 30-year Treasury yield and a 12-year low in consumer confidence.
recommendation: Mapped policy state is EA_ON with Tail below the watch threshold. The published forecast marks a narrow danger window from 12:00Z to 15:00Z covering ADP, the PCE cluster, the U.S. cash open and Chicago PMI, and a secondary event window around the 20:30Z Micron earnings call.
headline: Quiet overnight NQ range keeps Tail low at 16 while a 24-year high in long-end yields holds Stress high
body: Nasdaq-100 cash closed at 30,339.33, up 0.21%, inside a contained 0.64% session range of 30,235.67 to 30,429.97, while the broader tape was weaker with the Nasdaq Composite down 0.09%, the S&P 500 down 0.16% and the Dow down 0.26% at 51,349.92. That divergence reflects narrow megacap leadership rather than broad participation: of eight tracked megacaps only three were higher on the latest session, with Meta up 3.24% and Apple down 2.66%. NQ futures reopened at 22:00Z and have since held a 30,655.00 to 30,737.00 band, quoting 30,720.00 and up 0.35% on a delayed feed as of 00:17Z, a span worth only 0.27% of index level with the reopen low intact and the high extending gradually. VIX is 16.04, near the low of a 15.73 to 16.44 range. The dominant stressor is the bond market: the 30-year Treasury yield reached 5.62%, its highest since June 2002, in a sixth consecutive session of increases, while the 10-year touched roughly 5.29%. Consumer confidence fell 6.7 points to 81.9, its lowest since 2014 and well below the 89 expected, with the present-situation index down to 109.3, and JOLTS job openings eased to 7.097 million. New York Fed President John Williams said there is no urgency for the next increase while still seeing one more late this year likely, which pulled the 2-year lower even as the long end sold off. Crude eased, with WTI at $89.31 and Brent at $96.00, as Saudi East-West pipeline exports resumed and regional flows recovered toward pre-war levels. Taken together the environment is genuinely difficult, so Stress is held high at 67, but the observed NQ price path is orderly and two-way with completed retracements and no repeated extension, so Tail remains low at 16. The forecast raises Tail to a 23 to 24 peak across the 12:00Z to 14:00Z window, where ADP, the PCE cluster, the cash open and Chicago PMI land together, and to 20 around the post-close Micron report, in both cases as conditional event risk rather than observed structure.

lookbackSummary: Across the 24 hours to 00:00Z, published Claude Tail ran from 17 through a 24 peak during the European morning and the 15:00Z hour, then decayed steadily to 17 by 23:00Z as the U.S. session closed in an orderly contained range. Stress fell from 76 to 68 over the same window while Confidence held at 87 to 88. The 14:00Z hour has no published assessment and is marked unavailable.
outlookSummary: The conditional path keeps Tail at 16 to 19 through the Asian and European sessions on a contained-range assumption, peaks at 23 to 24 across the 12:00Z to 14:00Z block where ADP, the PCE cluster, the U.S. cash open and Chicago PMI land together, decays to 17 to 18 through the U.S. afternoon, then rises to 20 around the 20:30Z Micron earnings call and the thin post-close hour before easing to 17 late in the evening. Stress stays high throughout because the long-end yield and consumption backdrop is unchanged by any single print.
